about.title: About Us
about.intro: NatureHelp is a platform for monitoring environmental issues and soil/water deficiencies.
about.missionText: Promote environmental responsibility by providing people with tools and knowledge to care for the natural world around them.
about.supportResearchers: Support researchers with tools for analyzing and mapping laboratory data
about.visualizeChanges: Visualize environmental changes through interactive maps and real-time reports
about.involveCommunities: Engage communities in protecting their ecosystems
about.enableMonitoring: Enable transparent monitoring of soil and water conditions
about.whyItMattersText: NatureHelp connects data with action — empowering every user to become part of the solution for a greener future.

section1.title: 1. General Provisions
section1.content: This Privacy Policy describes how we collect, use and protect your personal information when using the NatureHelp platform.

section2.title: 2. Information Collection
section2.content: We collect information that you provide to us directly, as well as information that we receive automatically when using our service.

section3.title: 3. Use of Information
section3.content: Your information is used to provide services, improve service quality and ensure platform security.

section4.title: 4. Information Protection
section4.content: We take all necessary measures to protect your personal information from unauthorized access, modification, disclosure or destruction.

section5.title: 5. Information Sharing with Third Parties
section5.content: We do not share your personal information with third parties without your consent, except as required by law.

section6.title: 6. Your Rights
section6.content: You have the right to access, correct, delete and restrict the processing of your personal data.

section7.title: 7. Cookies
section7.content: Our website uses cookies to improve functionality and analyze usage.

section8.title: 8. Policy Changes
section8.content: We may update this Privacy Policy. We will notify you of significant changes in advance.

hours.title: Working Hours
hours.content: We work Monday through Friday from 9:00 to 18:00 (Kyiv time). Email responses are sent within 24 hours.

response.title: Response Time
response.content: We strive to respond to all inquiries as quickly as possible. Usually, responses are received within 24 hours on business days.
